analysis_set.span: POPULATION: Randomised set (RS): included all randomised participants, whether treated or not.

treatment_strategy.span: were randomly allocated to receive empagliflozin (10 mg once daily) or matching placebo using minimized randomization with a 10% stochastic element.

follow_up.span: TIME FRAME: From the day of randomization in the interventional part of the trial until the individual day of end of study in the non-interventional part of the trial. Up to 1869 days. | POPULATION: Randomised set (RS):

served_mismatch: For the requested longest trial-reported follow-up, the registry reports the overall-study primary composite HR 0.79 (95% CI 0.72 to 0.87), through up to 1869 days. The served HR 0.72 (95% CI 0.64 to 0.82) correctly describes the publication's interventional-period primary composite at median 2.0 years, but is not the longest follow-up held.

candidate_rejections.span: The primary outcome of kidney disease progression or death from cardiovascular causes occurred in 432 participants (13.1%) in the empagliflozin group and 558 participants (16.9%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.72; 95% CI 0.64 to 0.82; P<0.001)
candidate_rejections.why: Valid interventional-period result; rejected for the longest-follow-up extraction because the held registry reports the overall-study primary outcome including post-trial follow-up.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Adults meeting CKD entry criteria fall within the question's population; the bound overall-study analysis includes all randomized participants.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Adults with a race-adjusted CKD-EPI 16 eGFR of at least 20 but less than 45 ml per minute per 1.73 m 2 of body-surface area (irrespective of level of albuminuria); or an eGFR of at least 45 but less than 90 ml per minute per 1.73 m 2 with a urinary ACR of at least 200 mg/g at the screening visit were eligible

notes: Registry spans are used because only the registry holds the longer overall-study result. Interpreted the requested timepoint as longest follow-up, including the non-interventional period; treatment_strategy describes original randomization, not continued blinded treatment throughout that period. The registry's overall-study primary definition differs in wording from its interventional definition, omitting explicit ESKD and stating more than 40% eGFR decline.
